run_pump_code_generation: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert pump source text to generated code using the ConvertFromPumpSource function
parse_pump_ast: parse pump source text into an AST using the ParseToAST function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines using the BeautifyCode function
tokenize_pump_source: tokenize pump source text into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
